Class XmlOrthographyElementFilterType

java.lang.Object
ca.phon.session.io.xml.v2_0.XmlTierElementFilterType
ca.phon.session.io.xml.v2_0.XmlOrthographyElementFilterType
public class XmlOrthographyElementFilterType extends XmlTierElementFilterType
Orthography element filter for cross tier alignment

Java class for orthographyElementFilterType complex type.

The following schema fragment specifies the expected content contained within this class. 

 <complexType name="orthographyElementFilterType">
   <complexContent>
     <extension base="{https://phon.ca/ns/session}tierElementFilterType">
       <sequence>
         <element ref="{https://phon.ca/ns/session}selectedOrthographyElements"/>
       </sequence>
       <attribute name="includeOmitted" type="{http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema}boolean" default="false" />
       <attribute name="includeXXX" type="{http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema}boolean" default="false" />
       <attribute name="includeYYY" type="{http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema}boolean" default="false" />
       <attribute name="includeWWW" type="{http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema}boolean" default="false" />
       <attribute name="includeExcluded" type="{http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema}boolean" default="false" />
       <attribute name="useReplacement" type="{http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema}boolean" default="false" />
     </extension>
   </complexContent>
 </complexType>

    • getSelectedOrthographyElements

      public List<XmlAlignableOrthographyTypes> getSelectedOrthographyElements()
      Gets the value of the selectedOrthographyElements property.

      This accessor method returns a reference to the live list, not a snapshot. Therefore any modification you make to the returned list will be present inside the Jakarta XML Binding object. This is why there is not a set method for the selectedOrthographyElements property.

      For example, to add a new item, do as follows: 

          getSelectedOrthographyElements().add(newItem);

      Objects of the following type(s) are allowed in the list XmlAlignableOrthographyTypes
